title: Disgusting + GCD (Checker Version)
statement: Starting from a (up to 10^5), the task is to reach b (up to 10^9) with the fewest additions of a positive x coprime to the current value. Since gcd(c, x) = gcd(c, c+x), this is a shortest increasing chain whose neighbours are coprime: one step if gcd(a, b) = 1, two if a short brute-force scan above a (under 40 values) finds one coprime to both, otherwise three.
